title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go; parity fixes + version bump v1.208.0
author: Asha Patel
description:
Unify SDK behaviors for auth + retries and improve streaming ergonomics across Python, TypeScript, and Go. Motivation: multiple downstream teams reported inconsistent retry semantics and slightly different streaming ergonomics between SDKs which led to duplicated app-level retry logic and integration errors (see ENG-4231). This PR: 1) formalizes auth credential refresh and retry semantics across languages (opaque token refresh, 401/403 retry behavior, configurable backoff jitter); 2) stabilizes streaming APIs to support Cancellable streams, uniform callback/event models and an optional unified async iterator interface in TS/Python; 3) fixes a set of parity bugs discovered during cross-SDK QA (payload header handling, streaming chunk delimiting, and retry-on-idempotent-requests policy); 4) bumps SDK versions to v1.208.0 and updates changelogs. Checklist:
- [x] Python: auth refresh + retries implemented, added high-level StreamingClient wrapper for iterator + cancellable context
- [x] TypeScript: identical retry policy, improved stream API with EventEmitter + async iterator support
- [x] Go: token refresh hook + consistent retry behavior, context cancelation integrated into StreamReader
- [x] Tests: unit + integration smoke for all three SDKs
- [x] Docs: single migration guide and changelog updates
- [x] CI: green after rerun
Implementation notes: retry defaults are conservative to avoid double-execution (max 3 retries for idempotent ops, exponential backoff with jitter). Token refresh is performed transparently by SDKs using a pluggable credential provider interface; providers may opt into synchronous or background refresh to match environment constraints. Streaming ergonomics align on a small surface area: StartStream(), on('data'), on('error'), cancel()/close(), and for Python/TS an async iterator view over the same underlying stream to ease adoption. Backwards compatibility: default retry config preserves previous behavior for simple cases; advanced consumers can opt into new policy via client options. Testing: added a small integration harness that simulates transient auth failures and network interruptions to validate retry + resume semantics. Migration: documented in docs/sdks/migration-v1.208.0.md. Related: ENG-4322 tracks follow-up for observability hooks on stream health.
